So let me start with the key highlights of the financial performance of the quarter ended 
September '26. The bank declared the highest of its quarterly net profit of INR426 crores for the 
Q2 financial year FY '26-'27, registering a growth of 21% compared to INR351 crores in the Q2 
of FY '25-'26. 
The total deposit of the bank grew by 19% to INR1,37,279 crores from INR1,15,635 crores on 
a Y-o-Y basis. The gross advances of the bank grew by 19% to INR1,09,517 crores from 
INR92,286 crores on a Y-o-Y basis. During the last financial year, we had done a technical 
write-off of INR1,163 crores, excluding this Y-o-Y growth translates to 20%. 
Total business of the bank grew by 19% to INR2,46,796 crores. Net interest margin for the 
quarter was at 3.33 percentage, which was sequentially up by 10 basis points and on a Y-o-Y 
basis the NIM was up by 53 basis points. 
The bank was able to show a healthy growth in the average advances during this period with a 
growth of 20%. Bank declared a return on asset of 1.08% and an ROE of 14% for the quarter 
ended Q2 FY '26-'27.

Bank declared its highest net interest income for the quarter of INR1,116 crores with a growth

quarters to achieve the desired targets. I will also take this moment to thank my previous MD 
and CEO, who was mainly responsible for this quarter end, Mr. P.R. Seshadri, for this wonderful 
performance.
